object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Resolve merges in which: both sides created an object under the same ID; one side created and deleted objects; one side records a number above every merged object; two documents conflict at once; neither side records a number; one side records none. Then create an object. Expected: each merged document records the highest of both sides' numbers and one more than its highest object number, a side with no number counting as 0, and the object created afterwards gets an ID never given out on either side.
